decision.question: Is the source mug visibly positioned to the right of the same headphones in the edited image?
decision.criteria: Pass only when visual evidence reliably establishes that the source mug itself is now positioned to the right of the same headphones. Fail when visual evidence reliably establishes that the source mug is not positioned to their right, including when a right-side mug cannot reliably be identified as the source mug. Use unknown when the evidence cannot reliably establish whether the source mug is positioned to the right. Do not infer source-mug identity or fulfillment from color or position alone, or from unrelated/newly generated mugs.
decision.binding: Compare the source image's large light-blue mug, including its body and handle, with the edited mugs, allowing for changes in appearance, scale, and lighting. Compare the same headphones and determine whether the source mug is visibly to their right. Do not treat color alone, an indistinct blur, or a different-looking mug as proof of source-mug identity. A pass means the requested placement is fulfilled.
